theme: a small candlelit chapel in a cathedral crypt: textiles, woods and devotional objects

tiles.prompt: white altar linen with fine gold thread embroidery of crosses and vines
warm reddish cedar wood planks with straight grain and small knots

warm yellow ochre lime plaster wall, slightly uneven, faint brush marks
